CITY OF SAN DIMAS
  EQUESTRIAN COMMISSION MEETING
  AGENDA
  Tuesday, May 2, 2023 at 6:00 p.m.
  245 E. Bonita Avenue
  City Council Chambers
____________________________________________________________________________

  1. Call to Order and Flag Salute

  2. Roll Call

  3. Consent Calendar
  -Approval of Minutes from March 7, 2023

  4. Director’s Report

  5. Chair’s Report

  6. Commissioner’s Reports

  7. Council Liaison Report

  8. Oral Communications or Items not on the Agenda

(Members of the audience are invited to address the Equestrian Commission on any
item on this agenda or not on this agenda. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the
legislative body is prohibited from engaging in discussion on any item not appearing on
the posted meeting agenda. However, your concerns may be forwarded to staff or set
for discussion at a later date. Each speaker will be limited to speaking once for up to (3)
three minutes.)

Adjournment:

The next scheduled Commission meeting will be on September 5, 2023, at 6:00 P.M.

The regularly scheduled Commission meeting for Tuesday, July 4, 2023 is cancelled
due to holiday and lack of business.
